title: AROMA-CAFE
description:
Aroma Cafe & Restaurant Management Platform

=>Overview
Aroma Cafe is a modern, full-featured web application designed to bridge the gap between in-store cafe management and digital ordering. It provides a seamless experience for both customers ordering their favorite coffee and administrators managing the daily operations of a bustling cafe.

=> The Problem Solved
Local cafes and restaurants often face the challenge of managing multi-channel orders—balancing walk-in customers, table reservations, and online takeaway orders. Relying on third-party apps eats into profit margins, while using fragmented systems leads to missed orders and poor customer communication. 

Aroma Cafe solves this by providing a unified, proprietary platform where customers can effortlessly place orders and book tables, while the kitchen staff receives real-time, actionable alerts (including audio chimes) the second an order is placed. It eliminates the need for expensive third-party aggregators and gives the cafe full control over its digital storefront and customer data.

=> Tech Stack & Technologies Used
- **Frontend Framework:** Next.js (React) utilizing the App Router and Server Actions for a hybrid rendering approach.
- **Styling & UI:** Tailwind CSS combined with shadcn/ui for beautiful, accessible, and responsive components.
- **Backend & Real-time Database:** Firebase (Firestore) for instantaneous data synchronization.
- **Authentication:** Firebase Auth (Email/Password & Google OAuth) with custom Admin Claims.
- **State Management:** Zustand for lightweight, fast, and scalable global state (managing carts, user sessions, and live order queues).
- **Form Handling:** React Hook Form paired with Zod for robust, type-safe validation.
- **Media Management:** Cloudinary for optimized image hosting and delivery.

=>Our Approach
The architecture was divided into two distinct experiences driven by a single real-time database:
1. **The Customer Storefront:** Focused on aesthetics, speed, and conversion. We implemented a smart, persistent cart, 1-click reordering, and a smooth checkout flow. The UI features dynamic micro-animations to feel premium and engaging.
2. **The Admin Dashboard:** Built for operational efficiency. By leveraging Firebase's snapshot listeners, the dashboard acts as a live Point of Sale (POS) and Kitchen Display System (KDS). The integration of audio alerts for new orders ensures staff never miss a beat during a rush. Role-based access control (RBAC) was implemented via Firebase Admin SDK to strictly protect these routes.

=>Usage & Key Features
->For Customers:
- **Interactive Digital Menu:** Browse rich categories (Coffee, Bakery, Breakfast) with high-quality imagery.
- **Real-Time Order Tracking:** Watch the status of an order change from "Pending" to "Preparing" to "Ready" live without refreshing the page.
- **Table Reservations:** An intuitive interface to check real-time table availability and book slots.
- **Smart Cart:** Persistent cart state across sessions with seamless guest or authenticated checkout.

->For Administrators:
- **Live Kitchen Dashboard:** Real-time monitoring of incoming orders with dynamic state management.
- **Menu Management (CRUD):** Easily add, edit, or remove menu items and upload images directly to Cloudinary.
- **Reservation Management:** A visual interface to approve, reject, and manage daily table bookings.

=>Performance Optimization
- **Server-Side Rendering (SSR) & Static Generation:** Leveraged Next.js Server Components to reduce the JavaScript bundle size shipped to the client, resulting in fast First Contentful Paint (FCP) and excellent SEO.
- **Image Optimization:** Integrated Cloudinary to automatically serve WebP/AVIF formats and dynamically resize images based on the user's device, significantly lowering bandwidth consumption.
- **Optimistic UI Updates:** Implemented optimistic updates for cart interactions and order status changes, making the app feel instantaneous even on slower network connections.
- **Efficient Real-time Listeners:** Carefully scoped Firestore snapshot listeners using Zustand to prevent unnecessary React re-renders when the global state updates.

title: BLOOD-LINE
description:
Blood-Line is a full-stack web application designed to streamline blood donation and request workflows by connecting donors and recipients in real time.

Problem:
In critical situations, accessing blood quickly is hindered by fragmented communication, unverified donor information, and the absence of a real-time coordination system—leading to dangerous delays.

Solution:
Blood-Line is a real-time blood donation platform that introduces a structured, dual-dashboard system connecting donors and recipients. It enables instant request creation, live tracking, and efficient donor response, ensuring faster and more reliable access to blood during emergencies.

The platform implements a dual-dashboard system:

Receiver Dashboard enables users to create and manage urgent blood requests with live status tracking.
Donor Dashboard allows registered donors to discover nearby requests and respond efficiently.

Core system features include:

Secure user authentication and profile management
Real-time blood request creation and updates using Firestore
Structured data modeling for donors, receivers, and request lifecycle
Payment gateway integration (Razorpay test mode) to simulate transaction flows
Responsive UI optimized for accessibility and clarity

The project emphasizes real-world usability, focusing on reducing friction in emergency scenarios while maintaining scalable architecture and clean UI design.
